  TASKS   objectives                                                                          HELP

 │ KEYS                                        │ │ LEGEND                                      │
 │                                             │ │                                             │
 │ NORMAL — the cursor on a column             │ │ PRIORITY — the left edge of a card          │
 │   hjkl ←↓↑→   columns, and the band         │ │   ▌ low                                     │
 │   i           insert mode                   │ │   ▌ normal                                  │
 │   a           add a task                    │ │   ▌ high                                    │
 │   ⇧A          show what was archived        │ │   ▌ critical                                │
 │   ⇧X          take every task in this       │ │                                             │
 │ column off the board — it asks first        │ │ STALLED — the top right of a card           │
 │   /           search                        │ │   ⊘  blocked   waiting on somebody else     │
 │   ⇥           next tab                      │ │   ◉  watching  handed over, needs a look    │
 │   :           command                       │ │   ‖  paused    waiting on your decision     │
 │                                             │ │                                             │
 │ INSERT — the cursor on a task               │ │ OBJECTIVES                                  │
 │   hjkl ←↓↑→   tasks, and the band           │ │   ▶  active    being worked towards         │
 │   gg / G      first / last in the column    │ │   ‖  on-hold   not for now                  │
 │   ⇧hjkl       move it: sideways changes     │ │   ✓  reached   done with                    │
 │ column, up and down change place            │ │   ✕  dropped   given up                     │
 │   ⏎           the detail                    │ │                                             │
 │   e           the form                      │ │ ON A CARD                                   │
 │   f           take or let go the focus      │ │   ≡            a description exists         │
 │   d           delete                        │ │   ▪            sub-tasks done / total       │
 │   x           off the board, or back on     │ │   ⚑            a label                      │
 │   esc         back to normal                │ │   ↳            what is in the way           │
 │                                             │ │   2d          a deadline close by           │
 │ EVERYWHERE                                  │ │   −3d         one that has passed           │
 │   ?           help                          │ │   ╔═╗         the task in focus             │
